summary: A grocery manager can clear several distributors’ empties from the stockroom with one pickup.
realLife: Portland distributors formed a cooperative that collected their containers together at larger stores beginning in 1987.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: cooperative membership and pickup manifest.

turns.what: A participating store sets aside one loading time for the pooled truck.
turns.pulledBy: The store and distributors have joined the same cooperative.
turns.writesBack: The manifest covers multiple suppliers at one stop.

turns.what: When mandatory redemptions end, the cooperative checks which stores still have unpaid return stock before canceling pickups.
turns.pulledBy: The repeal includes a closing period for retailers’ last claims.
turns.writesBack: The closing manifest names stores still holding returns.
